verdict.rationale: Linear documents a first-party 'Linear Agent' that can analyze customer feedback in bulk, and its homepage claims users can 'delegate entire issues end-to-end'. However, the documented delegation mechanism (issue delegate) is for developer-built or third-party agents, so how far task delegation goes with the built-in assistant is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what tasks the built-in Linear Agent can take on, evidence that issue delegation targets the built-in agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
